incidents.name: OSN LP dividend distribution drain
incidents.notes: The OSN token's transfer hook pushed USDT dividends to LP holders through its dividend tracker without any minimum LP holding time or contract-recipient check, so the attacker split funds across helper contracts, added liquidity, and immediately collected the accumulated reward pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: OSN token 0x810f4c6ae97bcc66da5ae6383cc31bd3670f6d13 created 2024-04-15 by 0xeac1d1cebf3165a5dbbd6367eba726a28266e81d (it deployed its dividend tracker 0x8e474bc29fb9a884b1fc297b0b4bbc465700a571 in the same tx); attack sender 0x835b45d38cbdccf99e609436ff38e31ac05bc502 is unrelated to the creator; no upgrade events
